description: Simulation Data of 10-Machine 39-Bus Power System is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Zhenyao Li. The 10-machine 39-bus power system is a simplified model of the high voltage transmission system in the northeast of the U.S.A. (New England area). It was presented for the first time in 1970 and has since been often used for scientific research and publications. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
